text: The bangaisgedaig are the warrior women of Celtic myth. It is a motif that runs across the old Celtic lands. Some of them were goddesses of war. The British Andraste and the Irish Badb count among these. So does the Gaulish Cathubodua. Others were queens who fought. Medb of Connacht led her armies against Ulster. Scathach of the Isle of Skye trained the heroes. Her daughter Aife did the same too. The pattern held in history as well. The British queens Boudicca and Cartimandua led their tribes to battle.
